He holds a black rectangular box for the POCO F8 Ultra and speaks with animated facial expressions, using frequent hand gestures to emphasize his points. (2) The shot cuts to a close-up of a smartphone with a blue, denim-like textured back. Sample landscape photos are displayed. A charging animation appears on the phone's lock screen, showing '100W' and '94%'. (6) The man returns to a medium shot, holding the blue phone and gesturing toward it with his free hand. He smiles and speaks enthusiastically as price information 'NT. 21999' appears on screen. The background remains the consistent studio setting with warm lighting.
